title: How to Renew Your Certifications
overview: When you join as a member, your certifications will remain active without writing additional exams. Your certification expiration date will be updated to the same expiration date as your membership. Membership can be extended indefinitely as long as 20 PDUs (professional development units) are submitted per year, and membership dues are maintained.
skills_measured: Review the official LPI exam blueprint for a detailed breakdown of skills measured.
prerequisites: Please note: Your certification must be active in order to achieve a higher level. For example, you must have an active LPIC-1 in order to acquire the LPIC-2. If your certification(s) are expired, please see Options 1 and 3 for renewal.
